analysis: Requirement SFMC-REQ-016 states that 'The targeting system shall be extremely accurate.' The term 'extremely accurate' is subjective and vague, offering no quantifiable performance metric or error margin to enable verification. This is also noted as Open Item 7 in Section 11 of the SRS.

quality_issues.explanation: The requirement uses the subjective phrase 'extremely accurate' without defining quantifiable accuracy criteria, such as maximum allowable angular or distance error margins. This leaves the requirement unverifiable.
quality_issues.recommendation: Specify quantitative accuracy thresholds (e.g., targeting angular error tolerance in degrees or milliradians) and resolve Open Item 7 with stakeholder input.

summary: SFMC-REQ-016 relies on the subjective descriptor 'extremely accurate,' which makes the targeting performance requirement unverifiable without defined error margins.
